Author: Valeriy
Comment Text:
Recently bought ASUS Vivobook 15 X1504ZA-BQ1411 as a second laptop for simple tasks — it's a great deal for its price! I needed something affordable for surfing, documents, movies — and this laptop fits perfectly.

Looks stylish, the blue color is nice though slightly marks easily, the body is sturdy despite being plastic. Easy to set up, worked straight out of the box. 15.6" Full HD screen is sharp, great for work and YouTube. Intel Core i3-1215U handles all tasks — Word, Excel, browser tabs, Netflix. 12GB RAM and 512GB SSD — fantastic value, everything flies.

Keyboard is comfy and backlit. Battery lasts 4–5 hours under normal use, which is fine for me. Enough ports: USB-C, several USB-A, HDMI — connected mouse, flash drive, even a monitor easily. Wi-Fi is fast and stable. Sound is decent, good enough for background music or films, better with headphones.

Nice bonuses — 180° hinge, dust/water protection (rare for budget laptops). Only con — charging via proprietary port, not USB-C. But for this price, it's minor.

Launched Resident Evil 2 Remake and Forza Horizon 4 on low settings — stable 30 FPS. Not for gaming, but still solid.

To install Windows from USB, you need separate SSD driver.

Not a gaming laptop, but for work, study, movies and even light gaming — unbeatable value. Bought for 16,999 UAH with a gift — super worth it. Recommended for anyone who needs a reliable budget laptop that performs above expectations!

Author: Alina Dymnych
Comment Text: Excellent laptop, amazing for the price. Got a great speaker as a gift. Perfect for a student.

Author: Vlad
Comment Text: Light and compact laptop. Great for work and study, handles light games. Looks good, lightweight. Matte screen reduces glare. Free speaker was a nice bonus too.

Author: Yulia Veremii
Comment Text: After a week of use — overall satisfied. The speaker glitches a bit when connected via Bluetooth. Works fine with cable.

Author: Andrii
Comment Text: Nice laptop. Pleasant to work with.

Author: Andrii Andreev
Comment Text: Good laptop, enough power for study and medium games. Great screen for YouTube and movies. I'm satisfied. Had some driver issues at setup — different Wi-Fi chips exist, so preload drivers before installing Windows.

Author: Endi S.
Comment Text: Specs match. Processor handles 4K YouTube easily. Didn’t test games. Backlit keyboard is handy, average brightness. No screen bleeding. Better airflow system than cheaper Asus models. You need separate SSD driver during Windows install.

Author: Sergii
Comment Text: Stylish and lightweight. Perfect for office tasks, medium gaming and web browsing. Good IPS FullHD screen, solid 12th gen i3 processor, 12GB RAM, 512GB SSD. Runs quiet and fast. Need SSD + Wi-Fi drivers when installing OS. Three keyboard brightness modes. Interesting color. Recommended.

Author: Oleh
Comment Text: Installing Windows yourself is hard and time-consuming. Many nuances. Better to buy with a setup offer or ask a specialist.

Author: Daniil
Comment Text: Very nice for everyday tasks and work. Glad I ordered it. Not as good as base M4 MB Pro or M3 MB Air, but still decent. Installed Windows and drivers myself — everything works including WiFi. Great service from Rozetka — polite staff, bot helped me restore canceled order. Thanks!
